content:
Use `let p` instead of `have p` (since `have` forgets the definition):
Or even simpler, in one single line:
```lean
lemma mem_ballWithin_one_of_adj {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (c u : V) (hadj : G.Adj c u) :
    u ∈ ballWithin G 1 c :=
  mem_ballWithin_of_walk G (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hadj SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
```
The length of `Walk.cons hadj Walk.nil` is definitionally 1, so `mem_ballWithin_of_walk G (Walk.cons hadj Walk.nil)` directly proves `u ∈ ballWithin G 1 c` without any `have` or `rw`!
